feedback: The candidate shows some improvement in damping and stability with increased kd and reduced ki, but it still fails to complete either track, with 2 line loss events per trial and significant steering oscillation (up to 0.219 on the s-bend). Progress remains low (6.25% on oval, 14.75% on s-bend), and the robot goes off track before completion. The base_speed reduction to 0.13 may have improved stability but did not enable completion. The controller gains and base_speed are close to the upper limits of responsiveness and damping without overshoot, but the integral gain might still be too high or the sensor weighting insufficient to prevent line loss and oscillations. To improve, consider further reducing ki to 0.05 to minimize integral windup and oscillations, and slightly increase kd to 0.08 for stronger damping. Also, try adjusting sensor_weights to increase the influence of the inner sensors (e.g., change to [-1.0, -0.7, 0.7, 1.0]) to improve line detection and reduce line loss events. These changes aim to reduce steering oscillations and line loss, improving completion likelihood and overall stability. Confirm improvements by monitoring completion, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation in the next race.
